description:
Install a brick chimney stack on the main roof of the sample house project in NCH DreamPlan Home Design Software.

Steps:
1. Ensure the 'Sample House' project is loaded in 3D view.
2. Navigate to the 'Building' or 'Roof' tools to find exterior accessories.
3. Locate the Chimney object in the library (often under Roof > Accessories or similar).
4. Select a Brick style chimney.
5. Place the chimney on the main roof slope of the house. Ensure it is attached to the roof and not floating or on the ground.
6. Save the project (Ctrl+S).
